title: PrecedentReport
description: RM3 Engineering Precedent Reasoning output (contract package §4). Advisory only; the report carries NO query-verdict field (structural honesty). schema_version 1.0.0. Identity view excludes report_id, content_hash, and provenance; report_id = uuid5(NS_MP, content_hash). References frozen RM1 enums (ManufacturabilityVerdictStatus/ManufacturabilityReasonCode/EngineeringVerificationStatus); reuses common primitives unchanged.

signal_source_rank.description: rank of the entry that produced the signal; null iff signal = NONE.

PrecedentSignal.title: PrecedentSignal
PrecedentSignal.description: Closed enum (report-level derived signal). Member change = MAJOR.

PrecedentEntry.title: PrecedentEntry
PrecedentEntry.description: Precedent-entry data (contract package §3). No independent id/content_hash; grounded by episode_ref.content_hash.

relevance_score.description: Per-mille relevance (1000 = identical, D=0). Integer to keep hashing deterministic.
